title: fix(app-shell): an object_extension list row names and opens the object it extends
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCMKMmBM3vWYAtbM4KFCXQ4)_

Fixes #29569

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6587248382, amended by 6587714478).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`object_extension` 类型在元数据列表里改用 `extend`（被扩展对象的名字）作为标识键。Studio「全部元数据」里，`.custom` 定制包的扩展行现在显示 `showcase_task` 这样的对象名，列头叫「对象」，点开即进入这条扩展；搜索框和定制标记也按 `extend` 查找。
- 为什么改：扩展条目按目标对象名存储，正文只有 `extend`、没有 `name`（`ObjectExtensionSchema` 拒收 `name`，服务端原样返回）。列表读的是 `name`，所以名字栏显示「—」，链接指向 `…/object_extension/(unnamed-0)`，打开是空页。服务端没有问题，名字可以从返回的 `extend` 得到。
- 风险与回滚：只是给一个类型登记列表配置（`default-schemas.ts` 里一条 `registerMetadataResource`），外加 en/zh 各一个列头词条。其它类型的行不变，有对照用例钉住。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/default-schemas.ts`（新登记的 `object_extension`）；新测试 `ResourceListPage.objectExtensionName-29569.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.objectExtensionName-29569.test.tsx`，预期 6 个用例全过；删掉 `primaryKey: 'extend',` 那一行时 5 个转红，只有对照用例保持绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/default-schemas.ts`**: `registerDefaultMetadataSchemas()` registers `object_extension` with `primaryKey: 'extend'` and `searchableFields: ['extend', 'label', 'description']`. This is the per-type list declaration `email_template` already makes there (`bundleMemberField`). `ResourceListPage` reads `config.primaryKey` for the name cell, the row link, the row test id and the customization mark, so all four now use `extend`.
- **`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` / `zh.ts`**: `engine.list.col.extend` ("Object" / "对象"). The list localises a default column header by `engine.list.col.KEY`, so without it the header read the raw key "extend". These two files are in scope by the claim amendment (6587714478).
- The Label column is unchanged: it shows the extension's own `label` (the spec's "Override label for the extended object"), not the target's label.

## Tests

- **New `metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.objectExtensionName-29569.test.tsx`**, over a client serving the item as the card measured it, `{ extend: 'showcase_task', fields, _packageId: 'com.example.showcase.custom' }`:
  - cross-package leg (`/studio/~all/metadata/object_extension`): the row shows `showcase_task` under an "Object" header, no `(unnamed-N)` row exists, and its link is `/studio/~all/metadata/object_extension/showcase_task?package=com.example.showcase.custom`; clicking it lands there;
  - the base's area (`/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata/object_extension`): the row is found by `extend`, carries the pair's "Added" mark, and links to the extension;
  - the mark is looked up by `extend`: a read listing `(object_extension, showcase_task)` as an override marks that row "Customized", and the other extension stays "Added";
  - search matches `extend`; the Label column shows the extension's own label;
  - CONTROL: a `page` row still names, links and heads its column by `name`.
- **Ablation:** with `primaryKey: 'extend',` deleted through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `89d62fcc` → `70bfea6f`), 5 of 6 go red; the control stays green. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Related ui tests (every test file naming `default-schemas` / `registerDefaultMetadataSchemas`, `engine.list.col` or the studio namespace, plus `packages/i18n/`): 64/64 files (524 tests) and 156/156 files (2451 passed, 13 skipped).
- After merging `main` (head `04cbc4f7`): the 12 `ResourceListPage*` / `metadataAreaHost*` test files, 95/95.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: 66/66 tasks (tests included through `tsconfig.test.json`). ESLint on the four changed files: exit 0, no output.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live, before and after** (showcase `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` + the Vite console on source, at `e832ddb1`). The extension was authored through the doors Studio uses: `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization`, then `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/showcase_task?package=com.example.showcase.custom`. The list read answered `{"extend":"showcase_task","fields":{…},"_packageId":"com.example.showcase.custom"}`.
  - Before: `~all` row text "— — — Artifact", link `…/object_extension/(unnamed-0)?package=com.example.showcase.custom`, which opened an empty "(unnamed-0)" item page. The base's area showed "— Added — — Artifact" with the same link.
  - After: `~all` row "showcase_task — — Artifact", link `…/object_extension/showcase_task?package=com.example.showcase.custom`, which opens the item page with `Extend: showcase_task` and its `fields`. The base's area shows "showcase_task Added — — Artifact".
  - The eight screenshots (list and opened item, both legs, before and after) are in the project's files under `issue-29569/`; the relay cannot attach images to a PR body.
- Noted, not filed: the source column says "Artifact" for this stored, runtime-written row. It is outside this card's surface and is not a name defect.

## Verification

Gate readings at head `20add007` (the fix and changeset); the changeset, sdui-manifest, nul-byte and published-files gates re-run at `04cbc4f7` after the merge of `main`, all exit 0.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (locked): 170 files passed, 2 skipped; 4972 tests passed.
- ui static checks (`check:phantom-deps`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:metadata-write-doors`): all exit 0.
